finalText:
**Root cause identified.** The evidence is conclusive — here is the diagnosis:

---

## Diagnosis: c066 — Service Unavailable

### Root Cause
**Service selector mismatch.** The service `c066-svc` selects on `app: c066-app-typo`, but the deployment `c066-app` labels its pods with `app: c066-app`. The labels do not match, so zero endpoints are registered.

### Evidence

| Resource | Selector/Label | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `Service/c066-svc` | `spec.selector` | `app: c066-app-typo` |
| `Deployment/c066-app` | `spec.template.metadata.labels` | `app: c066-app` |
| `Endpoints/c066-svc` | `subsets` | **(empty — no backends)** |

The deployment itself is healthy (1/1 replicas available, 1 ready), so the pod is running and serving on port 8080. The service simply cannot find any matching pods.

### Impact / Scope
- All traffic to `c066-svc` (ClusterIP `172.17.97.8:80`) is dropped — no backends exist.
- The workload pod is unaffected and running normally.

### Confidence
**High** — the selector mismatch directly explains the empty endpoints, which is the sole cause of service unavailability.

### Remediation
Update the service selector to match the pod label:

```yaml
# In Service c066-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: c066-app    # change from "c066-app-typo"
```

Apply via:
```bash
kubectl patch svc c066-svc -n siclaw-eval-yye-20260602 -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"c066-app"}}}'
```

This will immediately register the running pod as an endpoint, restoring connectivity.

## Diagnosis: c066 — Service Unavailable

### Evidence

| Resource | Selector/Label | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `Service/c066-svc` | `spec.selector` | `app: c066-app-typo` |
| `Deployment/c066-app` | `spec.template.metadata.labels` | `app: c066-app` |
| `Endpoints/c066-svc` | `subsets` | **(empty — no backends)** |

The deployment itself is healthy (1/1 replicas available, 1 ready), so the pod is running and serving on port 8080. The service simply cannot find any matching pods.

### Impact / Scope
- All traffic to `c066-svc` (ClusterIP `172.17.97.8:80`) is dropped — no backends exist.

**High** — the selector mismatch directly explains the empty endpoints, which is the sole cause of service unavailability.

```yaml
# In Service c066-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: c066-app    # change from "c066-app-typo"

kubectl patch svc c066-svc -n siclaw-eval-yye-20260602 -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"app":"c066-app"}}}'
```

This will immediately register the running pod as an endpoint, restoring connectivity.
